author: Eibiel26
title: Best local music player with equalizer
content:
I rarely write app reviews but I really want to appreciate this app. 

For local music listeners, this is one of the best option for you. Plays lots of format, built in equalizer, all without breaking the bank. Seriously what the heck is wrong with app prices in the app store.

The UI is pretty ok, hopefully they will continue to improve this app to be the best music player app!
